evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Agentic workflows, in which a large language model (LLM) calls tools to read and write data, are evaluated in two ways.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We scored each episode four ways: native scoring against gold state, an LLM judge, that judge given the policy document, and the boundary evaluator, a minimal rule-based check of whether a write was expected against whether one occurred in the trace.
